qualifier: motor coordination and locomotor behavior
name: Hindbrain–cerebellar development and motor coordination behavior
rationale: Members cover cerebellar, pons, brainstem, nigral and striatal development together with locomotion, motor learning, proprioception and righting reflex, which separates the theme from cranial-nerve, forebrain and vocal/auditory-behavior neighbours.

qualifier: antifungal C-type lectin receptor sensing
name: Antifungal C-type lectin receptor–driven cytokine production
rationale: Members combine Dectin-1, Dectin-2 and DC-SIGN signaling and fungal/protozoan responses with induction of IL-12, IL-23, IL-10, IFN-gamma and GM-CSF, whereas confusables center on interleukin receptor signaling, Th1 differentiation or IL-17/IL-18.

qualifier: clathrin-dependent, presynaptic vesicles and postsynaptic receptors
name: Clathrin-dependent synaptic vesicle and receptor recycling
rationale: Members concern clathrin coat assembly/disassembly, synaptic vesicle endocytosis and recycling, and postsynaptic receptor internalization and endosomal return, unlike the neighbour focused on vesicle docking, priming and exocytic release.

qualifier: NLRP1/NLRP3 control of interleukin-1
name: NLRP inflammasome control of interleukin-1 production
rationale: Members cover NLRP3 and NLRP1 inflammasomes, IL-1 precursor processing and IL-1 alpha/beta production and signaling, distinguishing it from neighbours built on pyroptosis, IL-18, AIM2/caspase-4/5 or chemokine production.

qualifier: mesoderm specification and migration
name: Mesoderm specification and migration at gastrulation
rationale: Members concern germ-layer and mesendoderm formation, mesodermal fate specification and cell migration in gastrulation, lacking the endoderm, primitive-streak/EMT, lateral-plate or heart-field members of the confusables.

qualifier: Golgi architecture and COPI intra-Golgi/retrograde transport
name: Golgi structural organization and COPI-mediated retrograde traffic
rationale: Members address Golgi ribbon formation, disassembly/reassembly, localization and retention plus COPI budding, intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER traffic, unlike neighbours centered on COPII ER export or TGN-endosome-lysosome routes.

qualifier: NMDA/kainate excitotoxicity and CAMKK–AMPK signaling
name: Microglial activation and CAMKK–AMPK signaling in excitotoxicity
rationale: Members join microglial differentiation, proliferation and activation with NMDAR-driven AMPK activation, kainate response, hippocampal neuron death and oxidative-stress control, the AMPK/excitotoxic part being absent from the microglial-function confusables.

qualifier: IFN-gamma signaling regulation and MHC expression
name: Interferon-gamma signaling and MHC expression regulation
rationale: Members cover IFNG receptor signaling and its positive and negative regulation, MHC class I/II induction, antigen presentation and TLR dampening, whereas confusables emphasize IL-12/JAK-STAT-driven Th1 or NKT differentiation and dendritic cytokine output.

qualifier: parental, female mating and aggressive
name: Parental, mating and aggressive social behavior
rationale: All three members are conspecific social/reproductive behaviors, unlike neighbours about male reproductive physiology, exploration/locomotor behavior or stress responses.

qualifier: nucleotide-sugar and acetyl-CoA solute carriers
name: Inherited nucleotide-sugar and acetyl-CoA transporter defects
rationale: Every member is a disease caused by a defective SLC35 nucleotide-sugar or SLC33A1 acetyl-CoA transporter, separating it from confusables about ALG/enzyme CDGs or nucleotide-sugar synthesis.

qualifier: ER-centred transfer plus Rab GTPase prenylation and activation
name: ER-centred lipid transfer and Rab GTPase membrane targeting
rationale: Members combine non-vesicular transfer of glycolipids, ceramide-1-phosphate, PI/PC and cholesterol at ER contacts with Rab geranylgeranylation and GEF activation, distinguishing it from flippase, phospholipid-catabolism and mitochondria-ER contact neighbours.

qualifier: mtDNA replication, transcription, mRNA stability and mitoribosome assembly
name: Mitochondrial DNA replication, transcription and mRNA turnover
rationale: Members concern mtDNA replication and repair, mitochondrial transcription, mRNA processing/stability and mitoribosome assembly, whereas confusables are dominated by mitochondrial translation steps and tRNA processing.

qualifier: FGFR3 activation and PI3K/PLC-gamma cascades
name: FGFR3 signaling and FGFR PI3K/PLCγ cascades
rationale: Members are FGFR3 ligand binding, adaptor and mutant signaling plus PI3K and phospholipase C cascades across FGFRs, unlike confusables built on FRS/SHC cascades of FGFR1/2/4 or non-FGFR PI3K signaling.

qualifier: assembly, cholinergic transmission and congenital myasthenia
name: Neuromuscular junction assembly, cholinergic transmission and congenital myasthenia
rationale: Members span acetylcholine synthesis/release, receptor clustering, synapse assembly with DGC and proteoglycans, and glycosylation-linked congenital myasthenic syndromes, the last being absent from all confusables.

qualifier: cAMP-linked insulin and growth hormone secretion
name: GPCR–cAMP control of insulin and growth hormone secretion
rationale: Members are GLP-1, FFAR1, acetylcholine, glucagon-family and somatostatin receptor signals and adenylate cyclase activation regulating insulin and GH release, whereas confusables cover incretin synthesis, nutrient receptors or calcitonin-family receptors.

qualifier: CXCL12–CXCR4-driven, T, mast and glial cells
name: CXCL12–CXCR4-driven chemotaxis of T, mast and glial cells
rationale: Members are CXCR4 signaling and induced chemotaxis/migration of T cells, mast cells and astrocytes, distinct from neighbours on lymphocyte homing integrins, monocyte CCR2/CX3CR1 recruitment or S1P-driven B cell migration.

qualifier: circadian clock and PGC-1α/PPAR transcription
name: Circadian and PGC-1α/PPAR control of energy metabolism
rationale: Members link BMAL1/CLOCK, ROR/REV-ERB and heme clock outputs with PGC-1α, PPARA, gluconeogenesis, thermogenesis, beta-cell and caloric-restriction responses, whereas confusables cover the core clock feedback loop, adipogenesis, glucocorticoids or lipid homeostasis.

qualifier: cranial nerves and ganglia
name: Cranial and peripheral nerve and ganglion development
rationale: Members address cranial nerve, cranial/dorsal root ganglion and sympathetic/PNS neuron development, migration and innervation, lacking the spinal cord, hindbrain patterning, gland or CNS axon-guidance members of the confusables.

qualifier: chromosome condensation, CENP-A deposition and lysine acetylation
name: Chromosome condensation, CENP-A deposition and histone acetylation
rationale: Members cover mitotic/meiotic chromosome condensation, centromeric CENP-A nucleosome assembly and histone/lysine acetylation, unlike neighbours about sister-chromatid cohesion, nuclear envelope remodeling or chromatin-remodeler complexes.

qualifier: replication stress and DNA topology
name: Replication stress response and DNA topological maintenance
rationale: Members concern fork reversal, R-loop processing, DNA topological change, protein-DNA crosslink repair and responses to hydroxyurea and camptothecin, whereas confusables focus on telomere maintenance or ADP-ribosylation.

qualifier: receptor proteolytic activation and intracellular-domain transcription
name: Notch receptor proteolytic activation and transcriptional signaling
rationale: Members are NOTCH1-4 processing, intramembrane cleavage, NICD-driven transcription and oncogenic NOTCH1 mutants, distinguishing the theme from Wnt, Hedgehog and ERBB4 neighbours.

qualifier: endothelin-dependent neural crest migration
name: Endothelin-dependent enteric neural crest development
rationale: Members join endothelin receptor signaling with neural crest migration, enteric nervous system and midgut development, unlike hindbrain, lateral-mesoderm, sympathoadrenal or gastric-motility neighbours.

qualifier: SUMO conjugation cascade and nuclear substrates
name: Protein SUMOylation cascade and nuclear SUMO targets
rationale: Members cover SUMO processing, E1/E2 conjugation, desumoylation and SUMOylation of transcription, chromatin, DNA repair and nuclear envelope proteins, whereas confusables concern nuclear pore and nucleocytoplasmic transport.

qualifier: reverse transcription and APOBEC3 cytidine-deaminase restriction
name: HIV entry, reverse transcription and APOBEC3 restriction
rationale: Members span HIV binding, uncoating and minus/plus-strand DNA synthesis with APOBEC3G cytidine deamination and its Vif antagonism, distinct from ADAR editing, HIV integration and coronavirus neighbours.

qualifier: lipolysis, lipophagy and fatty acid flux control
name: Triglyceride lipolysis, lipophagy and fatty acid flux regulation
rationale: Members concern triglyceride catabolism, lipase activation, lipid droplet disassembly and lipophagy plus restraint of fatty acid uptake and oxidation, whereas confusables emphasize lipid droplet formation and triglyceride/phospholipid synthesis.
